correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the full proof: F(omega)=omega ensures every cyclic Lipschitz fibre restriction is onto, giving equality for four dimensions. Binary adding-one preserves first differing coordinate; the displayed positive-gap bound yields globally bi-Lipschitz Cantor odometers for all d<1, including a zero-dimensional superexponential Cantor. Constant-r self-similar dimensions and positive finite critical Hausdorff measure follow from the separated-cylinder covering and uniform Bernoulli mass bound. Dimension one uses the full tent map. Lipschitz real-valued extensions, clipping and finite linear interpolation produce a globally Lipschitz triangular map whose orbit has precisely the m sections. Similarity scaling yields any finite positive measure ratios. Verified 32,688 exact finite checker cases separately; code is not treated as an infinite proof. No identified unproved critical lemma in the stated domain.

value.rationale: A complete natural metric spectrum for cyclic omega-limit fibres of Lipschitz skew products, a regularity refinement of the current topological classification. The result proves all 0<=d<=1 attainable simultaneously across arbitrary finite base periods, and realizes independent critical Hausdorff-measure ratios for d>0. Zero-entropy minimal Cantor constructions for each d<1 distinguish metric complexity from return dynamics. It is not a numerical table, arbitrary slice or mere necessary-condition corollary; the global Lipschitz realization and measure flexibility provide the substantive content.
